workload: 40x40 square lattice (1600 spots) and 48 genes, Poisson counts with a spatial block in 16 genes, default diffusion step until entropy settles.
notes: Each gene is diffused in its own Python loop over the same lattice stencil. One batched update across genes keeps the per-gene entropy stop and the scores, and removes that interpreter loop.

workload: 20000 cells by 10000 genes, CSC integer counts at 4% density, theta=100, clip=sqrt(n_cells).
notes: The Numba kernel visits every cell for every gene, twice, including structural zeros. A nonzero scan plus the closed form for zero counts (the same approach as the C++ kernel in this file) keeps residual variances and scales with stored entries.

workload: 10000 spots, 100 cell types, 6-NN spatial graph (70610 stored edges), 1000 label permutations.
notes: tracemalloc peak during the call is the (1000, 100, 100) float64 permutation tensor plus the full-size residual buffer inside std. Online mean and variance over the same shuffles return the same z-scores without those two buffers.
